purpose: Baseline of the existing general projection on a smooth manufactured Neumann problem with nonzero third boundary derivatives. No cosine or polynomial feature adapter implemented; no superiority claim.
lifecycle: One benchmark trial per independent CLI process; training and prediction use the public file runner. Begin only after the five-seed convergence queue; no GPU overlap. Do not start a new trial after 05:43 UTC.
outcome_policy: Publish both outcomes and timings, including failures. Do not tune budget, thresholds or source after observing results. No analytical teacher or early stopping.
